ollama.name: Ollama (on this PC)
ollama.help: Free and private. Install Ollama, then run “ollama pull llama3.2”.

lmstudio.name: LM Studio (on this PC)
lmstudio.help: Free and private. Start the local server in LM Studio.

pollinations.name: Free online AI (no sign-up)
pollinations.help: Nothing to install and no key. Needs internet; can be slow or busy at times. What you type is sent to a public service.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.help: Has free models. Get a key at openrouter.ai/keys.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA NIM
nvidia.help: Free credits. Get a key at build.nvidia.com.

groq.name: Groq
groq.help: Fast, with a free tier. Get a key at console.groq.com.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.help: Free tier. Get a key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Can also read pictures.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.help: Paid, pay per use. Create a key at console.anthropic.com → API keys. The model name can be changed (for example claude-opus-5-5 for the strongest, claude-haiku-5-5 for the cheapest).

fcc.name: free-claude-code proxy
fcc.help: Run the free-claude-code proxy yourself (default port 8082); it routes Claude-style requests to free providers. Enter its auth token if you set one.

custom.name: Other (OpenAI-compatible)
custom.help: Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat API.
